verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Babylon.js ships visual tools: the Inspector for scene editing, the Node Material Editor and the Playground. Nothing documents an extensibility API, editor scripting, or a plugin system for building custom tools inside those editors. The 3ds Max/Maya/Blender exporters are plugins for third-party tools, and scripting the runtime scene graph is a developer building block, not editor extensibility, so neither earns credit.
